about.title: About ProSiddhi
about.intro: ProSiddhi is a job portal that helps people in India find work, and helps employers find the right people to hire.

who.title: Who we are
who.body: ProSiddhi is run by {{company}}, a private limited company registered in India and based in Bengaluru.

what.title: What we do
items: Job seekers make a profile, search for jobs and apply — for free.
Employers post jobs and search for candidates. They pay for this with plans bought on our website.
ProSiddhi works in 10 Indian languages, on our website and in our Android app.

promise.title: Our promise
items: Job seekers never pay anything. Anyone who asks you for money for a job is not from ProSiddhi.
We do not handle wages. Pay is agreed and paid directly between the employer and the worker.
We check employers and job posts, and remove anything fake or unsafe.

refund.title: Refund & Cancellation Policy
refund.intro: This policy covers the plans and packs that employers buy on ProSiddhi. Job seekers never pay, so nothing here applies to them.

what.title: What you are buying
what.body: Our plans and packs are digital services. They are added to your employer account as soon as your payment is confirmed, and you can use them straight away.

cancel.title: Cancellation and refunds
items: Once a plan or pack is added to your account, it cannot be cancelled and is not refundable.
A plan runs until its end date. Job posts and candidate unlocks you have not used expire with the plan. Those from the one-time pack do not expire.
You do not need to cancel anything. A plan simply ends on its end date. To continue, buy a new one.

always.title: When we always refund you
always.intro: We refund the full amount if:
items: money was taken from your account but the payment failed, or was not confirmed to us;
you were charged twice, or charged more than the price shown at checkout;
your plan was not added to your account within 24 hours of a successful payment.

jobPost.title: Deleting a job soon after posting
jobPost.body: If you delete a job within 24 hours of publishing it, and nobody has applied, we give you back that job post.

how.title: How to ask for a refund
how.body: Email us at {{email}} within 7 days of the payment. Please include the email or phone number on your account, the date and amount of the payment, and the payment ID or invoice number.

when.title: How you get the money back
when.body: If a refund is approved, we send it to the same card, UPI or bank account you paid from, within 5 to 7 working days. Your bank may take a few more days to show it.

help.title: If something is wrong
help.body: Please contact us first, and we will try to fix it quickly. You can also write to our Grievance Officer. See our <contact>Contact Us</contact> page.

delivery.title: Delivery Policy
delivery.intro: ProSiddhi sells digital services only. Nothing is shipped to you.

how.title: How you receive what you buy
items: Plans and packs are added to your employer account as soon as your payment is confirmed, usually within a few minutes.
You can see them in your account and start posting jobs or unlocking candidates straight away.
Your GST invoice is ready to download from your account.

shipping.title: Shipping
shipping.body: There is no physical product, and no shipping charge.

problem.title: If your plan does not appear
problem.body: If your plan is not in your account within 24 hours of a successful payment, email us at {{email}} with your payment details. We will add it, or refund you in full. See our <refund>Refund & Cancellation Policy</refund>.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal information ProSiddhi collects, why, who sees it, how long we keep it, and the choices and rights you have. We have written it in plain words. If anything is unclear, please contact us.

blocks.p: ProSiddhi — the website prosiddhi.com and the ProSiddhi Android app — is run by {{company}}. We decide why and how your personal information is used, so under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 we are its "Data Fiduciary".

list: Job seekers use ProSiddhi free. We never ask a job seeker for money, and we never ask for your Aadhaar number.
We collect what we need to help you find work, or find workers. We do not show adverts and we do not sell your personal information.
An employer sees your phone number and email only when you apply to their job, or after they pay to unlock your profile.
You can see, correct and delete your information, and complain to our Grievance Officer.

sections.title: What we collect from job seekers

list: Account: your name, mobile number (checked with a one-time code), your password (stored only in a scrambled form that cannot be read back), and your email address if you give one.

Profile: your date of birth (to check that you are 18 or older) and gender; your home city or area and up to three cities where you want to work; a profile photo; a short description of yourself; your skills, your work history and the kind of work you want.
Documents you choose to upload, such as identity proof, address proof, and education or skill certificates.
Your activity: jobs you search for, save, apply to or report; the message you send with an application; your interviews; and messages you exchange with employers.
Your choices: your language, whether you are actively looking for work, which notifications you want, and whether you agreed to receive WhatsApp messages.
Account: your name and designation, your mobile number and email address (both checked with a one-time code), and your password (stored scrambled).

Business details: company name, company email, address and city, size, year founded, GST number and company registration number (CIN), and the documents you upload for verification, such as a GST certificate.
Your activity: jobs you post, applicants you review, candidates you unlock, interviews you schedule, messages, and your team members.

Purchases: the plan you bought, the amount and GST, and the billing name, address and GSTIN for your invoice. Card, UPI and bank details are entered on Razorpay's payment page and stay with Razorpay. We do not receive or store them.

Location: if you allow it, the app or website reads your location to suggest your city and show nearby jobs. We use it to work out your city, and where we can match a city we store the city's position, not your exact position. You can say no and choose your city from a list instead.

Device and connection: your IP address, browser or app version and device type, recorded in our server logs to keep the service working and secure; and a notification token if you allow push notifications.
Sign-in records: when you last signed in and were last active, and a record for each device you are signed in on.
Google sign-in: if you choose to sign in with Google, Google gives us your name, email address and a Google account ID.

How you use ProSiddhi: the pages and screens you open and what you do there (for example, that you searched for jobs, opened a job or applied), with your device type, browser or app version, language and approximate region (not your exact location). We collect this with Google Analytics to understand how ProSiddhi is used and to make it better. It is not linked to your name, phone number or email, and we never send Google what you type, your exact location or your documents.
We do not use advertising trackers, and we do not follow you on other websites.
To create and run your account, and to check your phone number and email with one-time codes.
To connect job seekers and jobs: search, recommendations, nearby jobs, and showing job seekers to employers as section 7 explains.
To let you apply, schedule interviews and get updates — in the app, by push notification, SMS and email, and on WhatsApp only if you agreed.
To verify employers and documents, check job posts for fraud, and act on reports, so that job seekers are protected from fake jobs.
To take payments, issue GST invoices and keep the records tax law requires.

To understand how ProSiddhi is used, such as which pages people visit and where they stop during sign-up, so that we can fix problems and make it better. For this we look at counts and patterns, not at your name or contact details.
To answer your questions and complaints, to protect ProSiddhi and its users from misuse, and to meet our legal duties.

blocks.p: We use your information because you gave it to us for these purposes and agreed to this policy, and where the law requires us to keep or share it. We do not use it for anything unrelated without asking you first.

sections.title: What employers can see about a job seeker

list: In the candidate list (before you apply): your name, photo, short description, skills, work history, the kind of work you want, your preferred cities, and whether you are actively looking. Not your phone number, email, date of birth, gender, documents or exact location.
When you apply to a job: that employer also sees your mobile number, your email, your home city or area, your application message, and the education and skill certificates we have verified.
When an employer pays to unlock your profile in the candidate list, they also see your mobile number and email.
Employers never see your identity proof, address proof, date of birth, gender or exact location.
An employer who has your contact details may keep them to contact you about jobs. If you delete your account, we stop showing them.
Job posts are public, including the employer's company name, the name and designation of the person who posted the job, the company's size and the job's cities.
Profile photos are stored so that they load quickly in the app and on the website. Anyone who has a photo's web address can open it, so please do not upload a photo you would not want others to see.
Nothing else about a job seeker is public.

blocks.p: We use these companies to run ProSiddhi. They handle information for us, under contract, and only for these purposes:

list: Google Cloud — hosts our servers, database and files, in India.
MSG91 (Walkover Web Solutions, India) — sends one-time codes and messages by SMS and email, and WhatsApp messages through Meta if you agreed to them.
Google Firebase Cloud Messaging — delivers push notifications to your phone. A notification may show a short preview, such as the first words of a message.

Google Analytics (Google Firebase) — tells us how the website and the app are used: pages and screens opened, actions such as a search or an application, device type, language and approximate region. It does not receive your name, phone number, email, what you type or your documents. We have switched off its advertising features, and it keeps the detailed records for up to 14 months.
Razorpay — takes employer payments on our website.
Google Sign-In — only if you choose to sign in with Google.
OpenAI — when our staff check a job post for scams, the text of that job post is sent to OpenAI's moderation service. No job seeker information is sent.

blocks.p: Our own staff see only what they need to verify accounts and documents, check job posts, help you and handle complaints. Some staff can read information but not change it.
We share information with the police, courts or government authorities only when the law requires it.
We never sell personal information, and we do not share it for advertising.

Your information is stored and processed in India. Push notifications (Google Firebase), usage information (Google Analytics) and job post checks (OpenAI) may be handled on servers outside India. We use only providers that protect the information, and we follow any restrictions the Government of India sets on sending data abroad.

list: While your account is open, we keep your information so that we can provide the service.
When you delete your account, it is hidden at once. For 30 days you can ask us to restore it. After 30 days we erase your profile, photo, documents, applications, messages and notifications.

As the Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines) Rules, 2021 require, we keep a locked record of your registration details — name, mobile number, email and account dates — for 180 days after your account is closed, only to answer lawful requests from authorities. Then we erase it.
We keep employers' invoices and payment records for as long as Indian tax law requires.

We keep a few records that do not contain your contact details: that an employer unlocked a profile (their receipt), job posts that were closed, a one-way code that stops the same person getting a second free trial, your acceptance of our Terms and this policy, and logs of actions our staff took.
Server logs are kept for up to one year, to keep the service secure, and then deleted. Backups are replaced on a rolling schedule, so erased information also disappears from them in time.

blocks.p: You have the right to:

list: See your information and who we shared it with — download a copy from Settings, or ask us.
Correct or update it — you can edit most of it in your profile.
Delete your account and your information — see how to delete your account.
Withdraw consent for optional things at any time: WhatsApp messages and notification types in Settings, push notifications in your phone's settings, and location in your phone or browser settings.
Nominate someone to use these rights for you if you die or cannot act yourself — write to our Grievance Officer.
Complain to our Grievance Officer and, if you are not satisfied, to the Data Protection Board of India.

blocks.p: Withdrawing consent does not affect what we did before. We cannot run an account without the information it needs, so withdrawing your agreement to this policy means deleting your account.
We reply to requests about your information within 30 days, and to complaints as section 16 explains.

list: Every connection to ProSiddhi is encrypted (HTTPS).
Passwords and one-time codes are stored only in scrambled (hashed) form.
Documents are kept in private storage and opened only through links that expire within minutes.
Our staff's access depends on their role, and their actions are logged.
We limit repeated attempts to sign in or to send codes, to stop misuse.

blocks.p: No system is perfectly secure. If a security breach affects your personal information, we will tell you and the authorities, as the law requires — what happened, and what you can do.
ProSiddhi is only for people aged 18 or older. We check the date of birth when a job seeker signs up. If we learn that someone under 18 has an account, we will delete it.

sections.title: Cookies and storage on your device

blocks.p: The website keeps a few things in your browser so that it works: your sign-in (including a secure sign-in cookie), your language, and any form you are part-way through. The app keeps your sign-in securely on your phone. The website also uses Google Analytics cookies to count visits and see how pages are used, and the app uses Google Analytics in the same way. We do not use advertising cookies. If you clear this storage, you may need to sign in again.
For a question or complaint about your personal information or about ProSiddhi, write to our Grievance Officer:

We confirm that we have your complaint within 24 hours and aim to resolve it within 7 days. If you are not satisfied, you can appeal to the Government of India's Grievance Appellate Committee at <gac>gac.gov.in</gac> within 30 days and, for personal data, complain to the Data Protection Board of India.

If we change this policy in a way that matters, we will update the date at the top and ask you to read and agree to the new version the next time you use ProSiddhi. We also remind all users about this policy and our <terms>Terms & Conditions</terms> at least once every three months.
For anything else, email {{email}}, call {{phone}}, or visit our <contact>Contact Us</contact> page.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: These terms are the agreement between you and {{company}} for using ProSiddhi — the website prosiddhi.com and the ProSiddhi app. By creating an account or using ProSiddhi, you agree to them and to our Privacy Policy. Please read them carefully.

list: You must be 18 or older and able to make a contract under Indian law.
Employers must be a real business or person hiring for a real job, and must give true details.
One person, one account. Do not use someone else's account or details.
Give correct information and keep it up to date.
Keep your password and one-time codes secret. You are responsible for what happens in your account.
Tell us at once if you think someone else has used your account.

sections.title: What ProSiddhi is — and is not

list: ProSiddhi is an online platform where job seekers and employers find each other.

We are not the employer, and we are not a recruitment, placement or staffing agency. We check employers and documents, but we do not guarantee a job, a hire, or that every user is who they say they are.
Whether to hire, the terms of a job and the pay are decided between the employer and the job seeker.

sections.title: Job seekers never pay — and we never handle wages

blocks.p: ProSiddhi is free for job seekers. No one may charge a job seeker any fee, deposit or other money to apply, to get an interview or to get a job. Pay is agreed and paid directly between the employer and the worker; ProSiddhi never takes, holds or passes on wages. If anyone asks you for money for a job, it is a scam — please report it to us.

sections.title: If you are a job seeker

list: Your profile and documents must be true and your own.
When you apply to a job, you agree that we share your profile and contact details with that employer, as our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy> explains.
Stay safe: meet employers in safe, public places, and never pay money or share bank details to get a job.
Post only real, current jobs that you are hiring for, with true details of the work, the pay and the place.
Pay at least the legal minimum wage and follow labour laws. Do not post jobs that discriminate unlawfully.
Never ask a job seeker for money, a deposit, original documents to keep, or bank details as a condition of a job.
Post only jobs in India. Recruiting for jobs abroad needs a licence under the Emigration Act, 1983 and is not allowed on ProSiddhi.
Use job seekers' details only to recruit for your jobs. Do not sell, share or misuse them, and protect them as the law requires.
A business account can post jobs only after our team has approved it. We usually review documents within 48 hours.

blocks.p: You must not post, upload, send or share anything that:

list: belongs to someone else and you have no right to use;
is obscene or pornographic, invades someone's privacy, harasses or insults anyone because of their gender, or is hateful on grounds of race, caste, religion or ethnicity;
is harmful to children;
infringes a patent, trademark, copyright or other rights;
misleads about where it comes from, or is knowingly false — such as a fake job, a fake company or a fake profile;
pretends to be another person or business;
threatens the unity, integrity, defence, security or sovereignty of India, its friendly relations with other countries, or public order, or encourages any crime;
contains a virus or harmful code, or tries to break into or overload our systems;
promotes gambling or betting that is not allowed, or money laundering;
breaks any law in force in India.

blocks.p: You must also not copy our data by automated means, send spam, or use ProSiddhi for anything other than finding work or finding workers.

sections.title: Reports, checks and action we may take

list: Anyone can report a job post or a user. We review reported job posts within 36 hours and remove what breaks these terms.
We may check, refuse or remove any content, and warn, suspend or close any account that breaks these terms or the law. Where the law allows, we may act without notice.
If we act on your content or account, we will tell you why, and you can complain to our Grievance Officer (section 15).

blocks.p: What you post stays yours. You allow us to store, show and share it as needed to run ProSiddhi — for example, showing your job post to job seekers or your profile to employers — for as long as it is on ProSiddhi. You confirm that you have the right to post it.

list: Employers buy plans and packs that include Job Posts (to publish jobs) and Candidate Unlocks (to see a candidate's contact details). Prices are shown before GST; GST at 18% is added at checkout.
Payments are taken by Razorpay. We do not receive or store your card, UPI or bank details.
We issue a GST invoice for every purchase, which you can download from your account.
Job Posts and Candidate Unlocks that come with a plan expire when the plan ends, and unused ones are lost. Those from the one-time pack do not expire. The ones closest to expiring are used first.

A published job stays live for 30 days. When a plan ends you have 3 days' grace: live jobs stay live and unlocked candidates stay visible, but you cannot post or unlock. After that, your live jobs are closed.
Every new employer gets one free trial: 1 Job Post and 3 Candidate Unlocks for 14 days.
If you delete a job within 24 hours of publishing it and nobody has applied, we give the Job Post back.

Purchases cannot be cancelled and are not refundable, except as our <refund>Refund & Cancellation Policy</refund> says — for example, we always refund failed or duplicate payments. How plans are delivered is in our <delivery>Delivery Policy</delivery>.
You can delete your account at any time — see <delete>how to delete your account</delete>. Earlier purchases are not refunded, except as our Refund & Cancellation Policy says.

We may suspend or close an account that breaks these terms or the law, puts other users at risk, or that the law requires us to close. If we close your account for no fault of yours, we will tell you why.
What happens to your information when an account is closed is explained in our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
We provide ProSiddhi as it is and as available. We work to keep it running and safe, but we cannot promise that it will always be available or free of errors.
We are not responsible for what users post or do, for the result of any job, interview or hire, or for losses caused by another user — except where the law makes us responsible.
For an employer, our total liability for any claim is limited to what you paid us in the 12 months before the claim.
Nothing in these terms takes away rights you have under consumer protection law that cannot be taken away.

blocks.p: If you break these terms or the law and someone makes a claim against us because of it, you will cover our reasonable losses and costs.

list: These terms are governed by the laws of India.
Please contact our Grievance Officer first. Most problems can be solved quickly.
Subject to that, the courts at Bengaluru, Karnataka have jurisdiction. This does not take away any right you have as a consumer to bring a complaint where you live.

blocks.p: Complaints about content, accounts, payments or these terms go to:

We confirm that we have your complaint within 24 hours and aim to resolve it within 7 days — and within 36 hours for a complaint about content that breaks section 7. You can appeal our decision to the Government of India's Grievance Appellate Committee at <gac>gac.gov.in</gac> within 30 days.

We may update these terms. If a change matters, we will update the date at the top and ask you to agree to the new version before you continue to use ProSiddhi. We remind all users about these terms and our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy> at least once every three months.
Email {{email}}, call {{phone}}, or visit our <contact>Contact Us</contact> page.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.intro: We would rather hear from you than have you stuck. Here is how to reach a real person.

email.title: Email us
email.body: This is the fastest way to reach us. We read every message.

help.title: What to tell us
help.intro: So we can help you quickly, please include:
items: The phone number or email address on your account.
Whether you are a job seeker or an employer.
What you were trying to do, and what happened instead.

report.title: Reporting a job or a user
report.body: If a job post looks fake, unsafe, or is asking you for money, use the Report button on the job itself — that sends it straight to our moderators. We review every reported job within 36 hours and remove it if it breaks our rules. If you cannot reach the post, email us and we will act on it.

scam.title: A warning worth repeating
scam.body: ProSiddhi is free for job seekers. Nobody at ProSiddhi will ever ask you to pay for a job, or ask you for your Aadhaar. If someone does, it is a scam. Please tell us.

privacyRequests.title: Privacy requests
privacyRequests.body: To see, correct, or delete the personal information we hold about you, email us at the address above with the subject "Privacy request". See our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy> for the detail.

phone.title: Call us
phone.body: You can also call us on {{phone}}.

grievance.title: Grievance Officer
grievance.body: If you have a complaint about ProSiddhi (about a job post or a user, your personal information, or a payment), you can write to our Grievance Officer:
grievance.timeline: We reply to every complaint within 24 hours to confirm we have it, and we aim to resolve it within 7 days.
grievance.appeal: If you are not happy with our decision, you can appeal to the Government of India's Grievance Appellate Committee at <gac>gac.gov.in</gac> within 30 days.

help.title: Help
help.intro: Quick answers to common questions about using ProSiddhi.

moreHelp.title: FAQs and guidelines
moreHelp.body: Quick answers and step-by-step guidelines (English only for now):

forgotPassword.q: I forgot my password. What do I do?
forgotPassword.a: If your account has an email address, choose “Forgot password” on the sign-in page and we will send a code to that email. If you signed up with only a phone number, resetting by phone is not available yet. Please <contact>contact us</contact> and we will help.

deleteAccount.q: How do I delete my account?
deleteAccount.a: Open Settings, choose Delete account, and confirm it is you with your password or your Google sign-in. Your account is removed from view right away. We keep it for 30 days, and only our team can restore it in that time. After that it is erased, except the payment and invoice records we must keep, as described in our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>. Read more about <delete>how deleting your account works</delete>.

support.q: How do I contact support or report a problem?
support.a: Go to our <contact>Contact Us</contact> page for our support details. Tell us whether you are a job seeker or an employer, the phone number or email on your account, and what happened.

signUpNoEmail.q: Can I sign up without an email?
signUpNoEmail.a: Yes. Your phone number is enough. We send a one-time password (OTP) to your phone to confirm it. Adding an email address is optional.

findAndApply.q: How do I find a job and apply?
findAndApply.a: Open Find Jobs and browse. Open a job to read the details, then apply. You can save jobs you like and find them again under Saved Jobs. Follow every application in My Applications, where you can also withdraw one.

costAndContact.q: Does it cost anything? How will employers reach me?
costAndContact.a: ProSiddhi is free for job seekers. Employers can message you in the app and set up interviews, which you will see under My Interviews. An employer who unlocks your profile can also see your phone number.

register.q: How do I register as an employer, and why is my account “under review”?
register.a: Choose Individual or Corporate, verify your phone and email, and fill in your details. A Corporate account also uploads business documents (GST, CIN, ISO certificates). “Under review” means our team is checking those documents, and posting jobs unlocks once they are approved. Until then you can browse the portal and edit your profile.

credits.a: There are two kinds. A Job Post is used each time you publish a job. A Candidate Unlock is used the first time you open a candidate's contact details. Looking at a candidate you already unlocked costs nothing more. They come in plans, and a plan's Job Posts and Candidate Unlocks are lost when it ends, except the single-post pack, which never expires. New employers get a free trial. You can see what you have left on your dashboard, and prices on the Plans page.

postJob.q: How do I post and manage a job?
postJob.a: Choose Post a Job, fill in the details, and publish. It uses 1 Job Post and goes live once our team approves it. Under My Jobs you can edit a job, deactivate or activate it, or delete it. You get the Job Post back for a deleted job only if nobody has applied and it was posted less than 24 hours ago. Re-listing an expired job uses 1 Job Post. A job we do not approve shows under Rejected, with the reason.

findCandidates.q: How do I find candidates and see their phone number?
findCandidates.a: Open Find Workers and search by skill, job title or keyword, with an optional location. A candidate's phone number stays hidden until you unlock them, which uses 1 Candidate Unlock and asks you to confirm first. Candidates you have unlocked are kept under the Unlocked tab. People who apply to your jobs appear under Applicants, where you can shortlist or reject them, message them and schedule interviews.

safety.title: Staying safe
safety.body: Nobody at ProSiddhi will ever ask you to pay for a job, or ask you for your Aadhaar. If a job post looks fake or asks you for money, use the Report button on the job.

stuck.title: Still need help?
stuck.body: Visit our <contact>Contact Us</contact> page and tell us what you were trying to do.

deleteAccount.title: Delete your account
deleteAccount.intro: You can delete your ProSiddhi account yourself, at any time. This page explains how, and what happens next.

how.title: How to delete your account
steps: Confirm it is you with your password or your Google sign-in.

what.title: What happens when you delete
items: Your profile is hidden, and your contact details are no longer shown to employers.
You are signed out, and you can no longer sign in to that account.
If you are an employer, your job posts stop showing.
If you own an employer workspace with teammates, deleting your account closes it for them too. We ask you to confirm this first.

window.title: The 30-day window
window.body: We keep the deleted account for 30 days. You cannot use it during that time, and you cannot undo the deletion yourself. If you change your mind, contact us within the 30 days and we may be able to restore it. After 30 days, your profile, documents, applications and messages are permanently erased.

kept.title: What we keep
kept.body: We keep payment and invoice records for as long as tax law requires, and a limited record that an employer unlocked a profile.

stuck.title: Cannot sign in?
stuck.body: Visit our <help>Help</help> page or our <contact>Contact Us</contact> page.
